title: Aligned at the Start: Conceptual Groupings in LLM Embeddings

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating bias using the nationality split of the Bias Benchmark for Question Answering (BBQ) dataset. The authors measure the logit probability of biased outputs on problematic samples, comparing the base model against a token-engineered model where the embedding clusters for specific stereotype-prone identities (e.g., Indian and Pakistani proper nouns) were modified into a single Gaussian distribution.
